value.title: Holders come from pij directory, not HOLDERS.md

sections.name: body
sections.value:
To map seats to roles in a round:
`pij directory | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);[print(r['id'],[l['seat'] for l in r.get('lineage',[]) if not l.get('to')]) for r in d['roles']]"`
(lineage entries without `to` are the live holders.)
